heritage.title: Heritage & Evolution
heritage.description: Le Clef Mot ('The Key Word') emerged from a synthesis of French linguistic heritage and modern neural illumination. The project evolved from a standard dictionary concept into a neon-noir analytical engine designed to unlock the soul of language through etymology.

items.label: Origin
items.text: Initial design system centered around the fleur-de-lis and lightbulb symbology (Knowledge as Light).

items.label: Milestone
items.text: Full i18n implementation and transition to a robust Next.js 16 + AI SDK architecture.

mission.statement: To illuminate the deep origins of human expression through high-power neural analysis and immersive neon aesthetics.

decisions.title: Scalability
decisions.description: Implementation of a serverless architecture on Vercel paired with Pinecone's vector search to handle massive linguistic datasets with O(log n) efficiency.

decisions.title: Performance
decisions.description: Optimized the chakra flow via Next.js App Router and edge logic, ensuring low-latency retrieval of etymological data through intelligent caching patterns.

points.label: Deep Root Analysis
points.text: Unlocking word origins using vector embeddings and large language models for precise semantic tracing.

points.label: Cledor's Wisdom
points.text: AI-driven linguistic insights provided by the internal analysis engine.

points.label: Bilingual Fluidity
points.text: Seamless English/French toggle with persistent localization via localStorage.

points.label: Vibrant Aesthetics
points.text: A design system built on high-contrast neon glows, glass panels, and sub-second animations.

points.label: Remotion/Fal Integration
points.text: Dynamic video and image generation pipelines for visual storytelling of word histories.

roadmap.status: Operational. System is currently deploying production-grade linguistic analysis.

performance.title: Edge Optimization
performance.description: Migrating more heavy computation to edge functions for sub-50ms global response times.

security.title: Audit
security.description: Phase 2 system hardening and Firebase security rule optimization arc.

features.title: Semantic Graphs
features.description: Implementing interactive visual jutsu to map the evolution of language across time and space.
